dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire My mind went on a rather odd path here. I mean teaching math to a child should be rewarded with a medal. Meanwhile a pet parent puts a couple days in with some hotdog treats and teaches how to sit and they think it is hard work.

@dogecoin_empire No. I want her to be submissive to me but an assassin with everyone else. She has to be balanced in life and have her own goals and priorities. If I have to know how to do everything so does she.
